info.name: MaroCOD API
info.description:
RESTFUL headless and stateless API for managing cash on delivery (COD) order logistics

To test the API run "php artisan migrate:fresh --seed" and "php artisan serve" commands beforehand

request.description: Registers a new merchant and returns an authentication token

Authenticates a merchant and returns a token using credentials in the body of the request

Example { "email": "demo@marocod.test", "password": "secret123"}
Returns all the carriers and their carrier rates

Returns a specific carrier and all its carrier rates by specifying the carrier id in the route's url:

/carriers/{id}

Returns the cheapest carriers of every city

The endpoint supports a "?city" parameter as well if the user requests cheapest carriers that delivers to a specific city

Example : /carriers/cheapest?city=Casablanca

response.name: Cheapest_Carriers

request.description:
Returns all orders that the current authenticated merchant owns

This request has a "no auth" authorization type and it is expected to trigger a 401 error, simulating when an unauthenticated guest tries to access order records
Returns all orders that the current authenticated merchant owns

request.description:
Assing a carrier to an order by specifying the order id in the route's url:

/orders/{id}/carrier

and the carrier id in the body of the request :

{ "carrier_id":1  
}

Only orders with a "pending" or "confirmed" status can change carrier

Updates the status of an order by specifying its id in the route's url:

/orders/{id}/status

and the next status to transition to in the body of the request :

{ "status": "confirmed"}

This request is expected to trigger a 403  
forbiden error to simulate if the current authenticated merchant is trying to update an order that does not belong to him

response.name: Update_Status_Non_Owned

request.description:
Updates the status of an order by specifying its id in the route's url:

/orders/{id}/status

and the next status to transition to in the body of the request :

{ "status": "delivered"}

Statuses will only change if the transition is allowed

Example: This request is expected to trigger a 422 error demonstrating the state machine using the transition Pending → Delivered that is rejected; see "allowed" in the response

response.name: Update_Status_Illegal_Transition

request.description:
Updates the status of an order by specifying its id in the route's url:

/orders/{id}/status

and the next status to transition to in the body of the request :

{ "status": "confirmed"}

Statuses will only change if the transition is allowed

Example: This request is expected to return a 200 success response since the transition Pending → Confirmed is allowed.

Updates the status of an order by specifying its id in the route's url:

/orders/{id}/status

and the next status to transition to in the body of the request :

{ "status": "shipped"}

Statuses will only change if the transition is allowed

Example: This request is expected to trigger a 422 error demonstrating the business rule that rejects the transition Confirmed→ Shipped if there was no tracking number in the body.

response.name: Update_Status_Ship_Without_Tracking

request.description:
Updates the status of an order by specifying its id in the route's url:

/orders/{id}/status

and the next status to transition to in the body of the request :

{ "status": "shipped", "tracking_number":"Q123456789"  
}

Statuses will only change if the transition is allowed

Example: This request is expected to return a 200 success response since the transition Confirmed→ Shipped is allowed if the tracking number is supplied.
Returns the count and percentages of order statuses that the current authenticated merchant owns

Returns the total daily, monthly or yearly shipping cost that the current authenticated merchant owns

This endpoint handles an optional parameter "?period" that allows users to specify the timeframe in the query by choosing one of the values : day|month|year

In case the endpoint is called without ?period the default value is "month"
Returns the calculated financial summary of the current authenticated merchant, this includes the total revenue, shipping paid, net_cash, delivered_count, returned_count and success rate
Logs out an authenticated merchant using the token supplied in the header
